title: Business cards
lead: Company wallet and employee cards on the Wirex Corporate API. Credentials are not the personal-card keys.
cardsLead: Issue a virtual or plastic card to an employee and set its limits.
issueLead: The employee is fixed at issuance. The card name must start with a letter or number.
needEmployee: Add an employee before issuing a card.
nameHint: Start with a letter or number. Example: Marketing card
limitHint: Leave a field empty for no cap. Wirex cannot store a lifetime limit, so the remaining amount becomes the daily limit.
wirexWaitingDetail: This card is saved for the company. It is sent to Wirex after the corporate keys and corporation registration are in place.
employeeLocked: The employee link cannot be changed after issuance.
effectiveDaily: Daily limit that will be sent
usageHint: This is not a real payment. It reduces the lifetime balance and recalculates the daily limit.

err.name_invalid: The card name must start with a letter or number and be at least 2 characters.
err.limit_invalid: Limits must be a number of 0 or more, or left empty.
err.shipping_required: A plastic card needs a shipping address.
err.quota_virtual: A company can hold 30 virtual cards.
err.quota_plastic: A company can hold 15 plastic cards.
err.limit_status: Only an active card can change limits.
err.lifetime_below_used: The lifetime limit cannot be below the amount already used.
err.cannot_block: Only an active card can be blocked.
err.not_blocked: Only a blocked card can be unblocked.
err.cannot_close: Only an active or blocked card can be closed.
err.cannot_activate: Only a plastic card that has not been activated can be activated.
err.expiry_invalid: Use a four-digit year, such as 01/2028.
err.usage_status: Only an active card can record spend.
err.lifetime_not_set: This card has no lifetime limit.
err.usage_invalid: The amount must be greater than 0.
err.lifetime_exceeded: That amount is above the lifetime balance.
